Seen 3 times out of 3 tries (also with the radio unticked). (on /user/settings)
bugs.expected: With no file selected the form should refuse the update with an error next to \"Choose new avatar\" (e.g. no file chosen), or at least not report \"Your avatar has been updated.\" — and the avatar shown on /eval should change if the message says it was updated.
bugs.actual: Clicking \"Update Avatar\" with no file selected shows the green banner \"Your avatar has been updated.\", saves the account as using a custom avatar (the \"Use Custom Avatar\" radio stays ticked after reload) while no avatar was uploaded, and the avatar on /eval and in the top-right account menu remains the same generated identicon. Seen 3 times out of 3 tries (also with the radio unticked).
reproSteps: Sign in as eval (username eval / password momentic-eval-1) and open /eval: the avatar is the generated light-purple identicon.
Open /user/settings and scroll to the "Avatar" section.
Tick the "Use Custom Avatar" radio and choose no file in "Choose new avatar" ("No file chosen").
Click "Update Avatar".
The page reloads with the green banner "Your avatar has been updated." and the "Use Custom Avatar" radio is still ticked after a reload of /user/settings.
Go back to /eval and reload: the avatar is still the same generated identicon, no image was uploaded.

bugs.name: Follow on a profile with a block relationship fails with a raw "Error 400 when calling …?action=follow" toast

The browser console logs "Response Status Error Code 400 from /alex?action=follow" and the XHR POST /alex?action=follow returns 400. The page looked identical to a normal profile, so the person has no way to know the account cannot be followed. (on /alex)
bugs.expected: Either the Follow action succeeds and the button becomes "Unfollow" with the follower counts updating, or the app explains in words why the person cannot follow this account (e.g. a block notice) and does not offer an action that cannot work. No raw technical error should be shown.
bugs.actual: A red toast appears at the top of the page reading "Error 400 when calling /alex?action=follow"; the follow does not happen (counts stay 0 Followers · 0 Following), the button stays "Follow", and nothing on the profile explains why. The browser console logs "Response Status Error Code 400 from /alex?action=follow" and the XHR POST /alex?action=follow returns 400. The page looked identical to a normal profile, so the person has no way to know the account cannot be followed.
reproSteps: Sign in as maya (username maya, password momentic-eval-1) — the seeded contributor account.
Open https://5503-i7o8fz8bj9kf9tmt09ztp.e2b.app/alex.
The profile shows a normal, enabled blue/outlined "Follow" button (0 Followers · 0 Following).
Click "Follow".
Same failure was seen earlier signed in as eval on /maya (https://…/maya): page showed an enabled "Follow" button, clicking it gave the same raw 400 toast and the follow did not happen.

bugs.name: Biography is silently cut to 255 characters but the page says "Your profile has been updated."

Nothing on the page warns that the biography was shortened. Measured: 302 characters typed -> 255 stored; 320 typed -> 255 stored. The /maya profile card shows the same cut text. (on /user/settings)
bugs.expected: Either the whole biography as typed is stored and shown back everywhere, or the form refuses the too-long text with a message saying what the limit is, so the person knows the end of their text was not kept.
bugs.actual: The save reports success, but only 255 characters are stored: the textarea now ends mid-word (\""...0123456\"" in the first run, \"...-abcd\"" in the second) and the end marker typed (END-AGENT7 / SECOND-END) is gone. Nothing on the page warns that the biography was shortened. Measured: 302 characters typed -> 255 stored; 320 typed -> 255 stored. The /maya profile card shows the same cut text.
reproSteps: Sign in as maya (password momentic-eval-1) and open /user/settings (the Profile tab).

Click into the Biography textarea (it has no character counter and no maxlength) and paste about 300 characters, e.g. "agent7-second-start abcdefghij-...-SECOND-END" (the first run used "agent7-bio-start 0123456789 ... END-AGENT7").

Read the green message "Your profile has been updated.", then read the Biography textarea again.

The same profile then contradicts itself: the header says 0 followers while one follower is listed. Reloading the tab shows the empty list, so it is a stale render, not a failed unfollow. Seen as eval -> maya (Persian UI) and as eval -> alex (English UI). (on /maya?tab=followers)
bugs.expected: After clicking Unfollow, the follower's card disappears from the followers list at the same time as the "Followers" count in the sidebar drops to the new value; the count and the list agree.
bugs.actual: The counts in the profile sidebar switch to "0 Followers" but the followers list still shows the unfollowed person's card (avatar, name, website link) until the page is reloaded. The same profile then contradicts itself: the header says 0 followers while one follower is listed. Reloading the tab shows the empty list, so it is a stale render, not a failed unfollow. Seen as eval -> maya (Persian UI) and as eval -> alex (English UI).
reproSteps: Sign in as eval (username eval, password momentic-eval-1).
Open the profile of another user, e.g. https://5503-i7o8fz8bj9kf9tmt09ztp.e2b.app/maya, and click "Follow" (the count goes to 1 Followers).

Look at the sidebar count and the followers list without reloading.

bugs.expected: After signing out, the Back button must not show the signed-in account's settings page: it should lead to the sign-in page (or a page that does not show the account's settings and the signed-in navigation).
bugs.actual: The account's Appearance settings page is shown again after sign-out: the whole settings form with the account's saved values (Theme \"gitea-dark\", Language \"English\") and the signed-in navbar (Notifications bell, Create \"+\", account avatar) is rendered, although the person is signed out and the top-right shows no user. Seen 2 times out of 2 tries (once on /user/settings/appearance). bugs.name: Repository search treats "%" and "_" as wildcards and returns every repository
bugs.summary: Searching for % and for _ lists harbor-handbook (every repository on the profile) instead of nothing, while a normal term such as zzz correctly shows \"No matching results found.\" — the wildcard characters of the underlying search are passed through, so the box does not filter as it says. (on /eval?tab=repositories)
bugs.expected: The search box should find only repositories whose name or description contains the typed text, like the zzz search does; a search for % or _ should show \"No matching results found.\" because no repository contains those characters.
bugs.actual: Searching for % and for _ lists harbor-handbook (every repository on the profile) instead of nothing, while a normal term such as zzz correctly shows \"No matching results found.\" — the wildcard characters of the underlying search are passed through, so the box does not filter as it says.
reproSteps: Sign in as alex (alex / momentic-contributor-1) and open https://5503-i7o8fz8bj9kf9tmt09ztp.e2b.app/eval?tab=repositories (profile of eval, whose only repository is harbor-handbook).
Click the "Search repos..." box, type a percent sign % and press Enter.
Observe the list: harbor-handbook is shown although neither its name nor its description contains a % sign.
Repeat with a single underscore _ in the same box and press Enter: harbor-handbook is shown again.
Repeat with zzz for comparison: the page says "No matching results found."
